## Tool Name

Name and version of the AI coding tool.

## Configuration File Format

- File name and location (e.g., `.cursorrules` in project root)
- Format (markdown, YAML, JSON, plain text)
- Any token/size limitations
- Link to documentation on the tool's config file format

## Adapter File

If contributing an adapter, paste or attach the rules file adapted for this tool's format. All content must be derived from `core/vibeshield-rules.md`.

## Compliance Notes

Any observations on how well the tool respects its configuration file instructions (strong enforcement vs. suggestions).
